mechanism: Parse tester HTML or Signals CSV deals into positions and draw trendlines on SubChart/MainChartReporter subwindows; UI for post-trade review.

why_new_for_mis: After full read this is report visualization chrome, not a market regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensor.
quote: Let us develop an indicator which can perform the aforementioned functions.

idea_name: Product-form CCI with empirical percentile levels
mechanism: Replace classic CCI division (price−mean)/stdev with multiplication (price−mean)×stdev so flat and trending sequences no longer collapse to the same reading; collect separate positive/negative empirical distributions and set asymmetric indicator levels as percentiles (e.g. 70% of mass between zero and level).
data_needed: Typical price or close; period≥2; level percentile 1–99; running arrays of rounded ±CCI/_Point
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a trend-vs-flat discriminator that classical normalized CCI cannot, plus data-driven asymmetric thresholds instead of fixed ±100.
quote: But to achieve this, we need to abandon division and replace it with multiplication. Then the indicator formula will look like this

idea_name: Half-CCI via windowed mean without stdev
mechanism: Drop stdev normalization after observing that (price−mean) residuals are non-Gaussian; keep only (price−mean) with rectangular, triangular, flat-top, LWMA, power, or exponential window weights, optional smoothing, and the same empirical percentile levels.
data_needed: Price series; chosen window weights; period; level percentile
why_new_for_mis: Removes unjustified Gaussian normalization and exposes window-shape as a controllable sensing prior for deviation-from-mean features.
quote: If the differences are distributed according to some empirical law, we can afford to abandon the standard deviation. Then our indicator will turn into a half of the CCI.

idea_name: Metabar Doji with Height/Width power filter
mechanism: Scan variable-width OHLC metabars (Candle_WidthMin…Max consecutive bars) for Doji body/shadow ratio limits; accept only candlesticks whose Height/Width (points per minute) exceeds Candle_HeightPowerMin so noise short metabars are rejected; emit ±width as signal height when formation completes.
data_needed: OHLC rates; body/shadow max powers; width min/max; height power min; SkipBars=WidthMax
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 vs H1 metabars width 4 / 3–5; M1 metabars 180–300; classical WidthMin=WidthMax=1 baseline
why_new_for_mis: Senses reversal-shaped exhaustion events on floating start times and non-standard durations that fixed TF bars miss (~6× more Dojis in the H1-vs-H4 test).
quote: So, we need to create a metabar height filter characterizing the strength of the price movement which is equally powerful and achievable for any metabars

mechanism: Precreate iMA/iCCI handles for period steps and rebind buffers on wheel scroll via chart button; interaction chrome around existing indicators.

mechanism: CIndMSTF copies foreign-symbol/period indicator buffers onto the host chart by bar open time; BufferLineState / BufferLineStateRelative emit ENUM_LINE_STATE (UP/DOWN/TURN_UP/TURN_DOWN/STOP_*/CROSS_*/TOUCH_*/ABOVE/BELOW/EQUALS) from three consecutive values or vs a level, with 90s timeseries hold and weekend tick emulation.
data_needed: Indicator handle on symbol/period; CopyBuffer/CopyTime; iBarShift mapping; optional level
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Test: host M1 with MA on current and M5; switches across M1/M5/M15
why_new_for_mis: Provides a reusable cross-TF/cross-symbol state vocabulary for regime-change detection without reinventing HTF sync and line semantics per indicator.

idea_name: Multi-year seasonal average of FX/metal spreads
mechanism: For a weighted pair spread (Symbol1 − ±Symbol2 with tick-value lot alignment), average same-calendar-day spread paths over N years (2/3/5/8/10/15) into a bold seasonal mean; thin yearly traces show pattern fidelity; trade with the seasonal slope (long only when average rises).
data_needed: Multi-year D1 (or H1) OHLC of both legs; weighting coefficients; Symbol2_Reverse for negative correlation
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD−GBPUSD; XAGUSD−XAUUSD; H1 spread charts; seasonal D1-scale analysis; MRCI silver reference
why_new_for_mis: Adds calendar-conditioned intermarket spread regime path as a sensing feature beyond single-symbol seasonality.
quote: quotes are taken for several years, after which the symbol spread prices are added up and divided by a multiplier corresponding to the number of years

mechanism: Build live spread = w1·S1 − (±)w2·S2 with tick-value volume alignment; treat deviation of spread from its MA (or Bollinger on First Indicator's Data) as overbought/oversold mean-reversion of the pair relationship.
data_needed: Two symbol closes; Weighting_coefficients; SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE/SIZE; BB/MA applied to indicator
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD−GBPUSD; EURUSD/USDCHF negative corr example; XAGUSD−XAUUSD H1
why_new_for_mis: Market-neutral relationship residual sensor for MIS co-movement / divergence detection.
quote: the difference between the spread chart and the moving average can be a good indicator of this movement. Thus, we get a spread oscillator.

idea_name: Chi-square independence of adjacent log increments
mechanism: Standardize log-price increments, trim tails to Tails σ, build i×j contingency table of lagged (X_t, X_{t−1}) bins via Crosstab, compute CHI2=(Actual−Expected)²/Expected vs χ²_v critical value at alpha; also emit Cramér contingency coefficient sqrt(CHI2/(N·(Bins−1))).
data_needed: Log returns window (Data); alpha; Tails (2–4 σ); bins after standardization
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Single-symbol adjacent increments on each bar (Chi2Test); Crosstab script for X vs Y e.g. EURUSD vs AUDUSD
why_new_for_mis: Hypothesis-tested serial-dependence sensor that flags when increments are not independent — a regime feature classical r≈0 can miss under heavy tails.
quote: The indicator tests the independence hypothesis on each bar between adjacent price increments for a single financial instrument.

idea_name: Correlation ratio nonlinearity vs Pearson r
mechanism: From the same grouped contingency table compute Nyx=√(D[E(Y|X)]/Sy) and Nxy; F-tests reject Nyx=0 and test Nyx²=r² (linearity); |r|<min(Nxy,Nyx) flags nonlinear dependence (demo: logistic map looks like white noise under r alone).
data_needed: Grouped (X,Y) contingency; ungrouped Pearson r for comparison; Bins_count; N; alpha
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Crosstab / Crosstab_Models (uniform, AR(1), ARCH, logistic map); FX pairs scatterplots
why_new_for_mis: Detects nonlinear / heteroscedastic structure MIS would miss with linear correlation alone.
quote: By analyzing the data of such a system using only the linear correlation ratio, one could erroneously conclude that this process is white noise.

idea_name: Adaptive GARCH(1,1) one-step vol and CI forecast
mechanism: Fit GARCH(1,1) σ²_t=ω+α ε²_{t−1}+β σ²_{t−1} (optional Student-t) by Max Likelihood via ALGLIB MinBLEIC under ω>0, α,β≥0, α+β<1; iGARCH re-optimizes each new bar and plots one-step conditional stdev plus Gaussian or Monte-Carlo Student confidence bands on log returns; validate via ACF of squared standardized residuals and Jarque–Bera.
data_needed: Close log returns LN(Y_t/Y_{t−1}); Data window; forecast_m; pci; Gaussian or t distribution
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD Daily (~4y sample); iGARCH on chart with Plot indicator bars limit
why_new_for_mis: Supplies clustered, forecasted conditional volatility and probabilistic price-increment bands beyond rolling historical σ.
quote: The indicator forecasts volatility (conditional standard deviation) and confidence intervals for future price increments with a certain level of one-step-ahead reliability.

idea_name: Multi-method binary price encodings with zero-entropy motifs
mechanism: Encode OHLC/volume into bitstrings via 15 rules (direction, MA cross, momentum>|thr|, volume>avg, fractal extrema, range>avg vol, body>half-shadow, return entropy, MA conv/div, pivot, RSI>50, z-score cluster, mid-range, polyfit trend slope, hybrid direction∧volume∧volatility); analyze repeating subsequences and flag near-zero local entropy stable patterns (optionally base58-compacted).
data_needed: MT5 rates (close/high/low/tick_volume); window lengths; thresholds; rolling means
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Bitcoin/ETH examples; EURUSD H1 last ~30 days in main(); M15/H1/H4 multi-TF combo; BTC 4H volumes
why_new_for_mis: Turns heterogeneous TA predicates into a unified discrete sequence alphabet and isolates low-entropy motifs as candidate regime tokens for downstream models.
quote: Search for stable patterns (with zero entropy)

idea_name: CatBoost predictor on binary pattern windows
mechanism: BinaryPatternPredictor slides lookback windows of each encoding into CatBoost features (bit sequence, ones-count, local trend, cross-method correlation); train without shuffle; predict_proba of next-window ones vs zeros with confidence; method disagreement used as reversal cue.
data_needed: Encoded binary series; lookback; labeled next-window majority class; CatBoost train/predict
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 reported metrics (momentum ~95% acc, volume ~83%, hybrid ~91%)
why_new_for_mis: Concrete sequence/neural sensor that maps discrete market-state codes to probabilistic short-horizon imbalance forecasts.
quote: That is how the idea was born to use CatBoost to predict future price movements.
